decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the products based on their primary function as backpacks, filtering out accessories like pillows, stoves, and tents that were mixed into the feed. My consideration set includes a range of styles: a high-capacity tactical pack (QT&QY), a high-quality EDC pack (Maxpedition), a budget-friendly hiking pack (SHENHU), a compact sling (GZ XINXING), and a premium technical winter pack (USWE). I chose the QT&QY 45L Military Tactical Backpack because it offers exceptional value for money, backed by over 6,000 highly positive reviews, and provides the versatility needed for travel, hiking, or daily use at a very competitive price point.
